title: Arboresce operations, lifecycle, export and feedback v1 contract definitions
description: Library only: select a named $defs target. The root rejects all instances. Structural validation does not establish exact hashes, cross-record joins, current authority, time arithmetic, inventory completeness, authentic evidence, continuity or runtime qualification.

positive_duration_ms.description: Representation bound only. A qualified profile must select a finite duration with checked clock arithmetic and remaining-authority enforcement.

propagation_repair_reference.description: Reserved exact association. Producing a reference requires qualified complete retained record bytes, current-authorized reads and the separately admitted repair capability; this reference does not enable an operation kind or route.

propagation_repair_batch_reference.description: Reserved exact association. Producing a reference requires qualified complete retained record bytes, current-authorized reads and the separately admitted repair capability; this reference does not enable an operation kind or route.

propagation_coverage_reference.description: Reserved exact association. Producing a reference requires qualified complete retained record bytes, current-authorized reads and the separately admitted repair capability; this reference does not enable an operation kind or route.

qualified_action_evidence_reference.description: Exact profile-qualified retained affirmative evidence. Hash and length alone establish neither authenticity nor outcome; complete producer/verifier contracts are required before use.

propagation_obligation_control.description: The initial operation and manifest remain immutable across separately admitted repair heads. Failure reason survives repair and later satisfaction. Counter minima and local branches are structural; actual increments and exact associations are semantic.

command_retention_limits.description: Terminal-relative selected retention durations. Diagnostic retention must be strictly longer than replay retention; pair comparison and timestamp arithmetic require semantic validation.

detail.const: Required retained operation details are unavailable.
The prior command cannot be replayed with this key.

feedback_source.description: Public feedback recording produces author_report. The qualified_observation branch requires independent server producer qualification before support.

operation_resource.description: Complete observed work, effect and exposure ledgers under one operation control. Terminal work is immutable; qualified bounded reconciliation and lifecycle confirmations may advance their retained observations without changing its terminal result.
